text:
ISTATS::remove
Description
Removes the given
iStat
entirely.
Syntax
ISTATS
::
remove
"<key>"
ISTATS::remove “<key>”
The “<key>” must be in quotes and identical to the key used to
set/incr/get the iStat.
ISTATS::remove is valid in all events/contexts in data plane iRules
and control plane iRules.
Examples
ISTATS
::
remove
"ltm.pool /Common/mypool counter some_counter"
